meta.titulo: NG Creator — From your podcast to clips posted on TikTok, Reels, Shorts and Facebook
meta.descripcion: For podcasts, TikTok lives and streams. The whole workflow in one place: upload the episode, it transcribes itself, AI finds the best moments, your team edits them with captions and approves them, and you post them to all your socials. Web and app for iPhone and Android.

datos.descripcion: Turn podcast episodes, TikTok lives and streams into vertical clips with captions for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. AI finds the best moments and your team edits and posts them.

subir.texto: The full video, one or three hours long, straight from the browser. If your internet drops, it picks up where it left off.

transcribir.texto: Every word with its exact second. It's the basis for the cuts and the captions.

momentos.texto: It suggests the clips that stand on their own, with their viral potential and why.

editar.texto: Auto-framing follows whoever is speaking; you add captions with the word highlighted and styled text. What you see is what you get.

equipo.texto: Everyone works on their own clip, and nothing goes out until a person approves it.

publicar.titulo: You post to all your socials
publicar.texto: Right from here, at the time you choose. No downloading the video or logging into each network.

autoEncuadre.titulo: The camera follows whoever is speaking. On its own.
autoEncuadre.texto: Your podcast is recorded with one wide camera on the whole table. For vertical, you have to pick who to show every second, and doing that by hand is what takes the longest. With one button, NG Creator watches the clip and builds the shot changes the way an editor would.

quienHabla.texto: It recognizes each voice and matches it to the face whose lips are moving. Someone gesturing, nodding or covering their face doesn't steal the shot from the speaker.

divide.titulo: It splits the screen when they argue
divide.texto: If three people talk at once, instead of jumping from face to face every second, it shows the table split: two on top and two below.

reacciones.texto: In a long take, it cuts for a couple of seconds to whoever laughs or reacts, then comes back. The clip looks edited, not recorded in one go.

ultimaPalabra.texto: Every shot stays in the editor so you can move or change it. You see how much each person got on screen and, if you don't like it, you go back to how it was.

webYApp.titulo: On the web and in the app
webYApp.texto: Start it from your computer or your phone, and it keeps working even if you close the screen.

lives.titulo: Your live ends. The clips are already ready.
lives.texto: A two-hour live has ten good clips inside, and hardly anyone has time to find them. If you stream from your computer, with TikTok LIVE Studio, OBS or Streamlabs, NG Creator turns your live into vertical clips with captions, ready to post.
lives.pie: Also for YouTube, Facebook and Twitch. In the meantime, you can already upload your live's recording like any episode.

transmitis.texto: With TikTok LIVE Studio, OBS or Streamlabs. Your live doesn't change.

llega.texto: With OBS or Streamlabs, you add NG Creator as one more destination and we record it while it's on air. With TikTok LIVE Studio, you turn on Record and upload the file: it comes out in better quality than TikTok's replay.

terminas.titulo: You finish and the clips are there
terminas.texto: Transcription, the best moments with AI, auto-framing and captions. You review them and post them.

convertir.p: How do I turn my podcast into clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts?
convertir.r: Upload the episode's video. NG Creator transcribes it, AI marks the moments that stand on their own, and each one opens in the editor already vertical 9:16, with captions. You adjust the framing and the text, and download the MP4.

tiempo.p: How long does it take to get clips from an episode?
tiempo.r: The transcription and moments for a two-hour episode are ready in a few minutes. After that, each clip takes a minute or two to adjust: the framing, captions and hook come already built.

descargar.p: Do I have to download the episode to edit?
descargar.r: No. The original stays in the cloud; editing and rendering happen on our servers. You only download the finished MP4, if you want.

sigue.p: Does the clip follow the person speaking?
sigue.r: Yes, with auto-framing. It recognizes voices and watches who's moving their lips, so it doesn't get confused by someone gesturing or covering their face. When several people argue, it splits the screen; in a long take, it cuts for a couple of seconds to someone else's reaction. Every shot can be corrected, and if you don't like it, you go back to how it was.

lives.p: Does it work for my TikTok lives?
lives.r: Today, yes: you upload the live's recording like any episode and get the clips. If you stream with TikTok LIVE Studio, turn on Record: the file comes out in better quality than the replay TikTok saves. Soon it'll be automatic with OBS or Streamlabs: you add NG Creator as one more destination, we record the live while it's on air, and when it ends the clips are ready. Also for YouTube, Facebook and Twitch.

subtitulos.r: Yes. They come from the word-by-word transcription, big and with the word being spoken highlighted. If a word came out wrong, you fix it without touching the timing.

app.r: Yes, for iPhone and Android, with the same account as the web. Today it lets you see your episodes and review the clips AI found; editing from your phone is on the way.

idioma.p: What language does it work in?
idioma.r: It's built for Spanish-language podcasts: the transcription, the moments and the captions.

flojo.p: What if the AI picks a weak moment?
flojo.r: Nothing goes out until a person approves it. AI suggests with a score and the reason; you decide, and you can also build clips by hand from the transcript.

episodio.r: Every long video you upload. You can get as many clips as you want from one episode, no limit.

portada.etiqueta: From podcast or live to your socials, in one place
